title: Mustard baked haddock with cabbage
summary: Haddock baked with a sharp mustard coating, buttered-without-the-butter cabbage and a few new potatoes. A lean fish supper that still fills the plate.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 190°C. Toss the potatoes with half the oil and half the salt and put them in to roast.
Stir the mustard with the lemon juice, parsley and pepper. Lay the haddock beside the potatoes and spread the mustard over the fish.
Roast until the haddock flakes and the potatoes are tender.
steps.tip: If the potatoes were large, give them the head start above. Small new potatoes catch up.

steps.instruction: Meanwhile warm the remaining oil, fry the leek for 2 minutes, add the cabbage and a splash of water, cover and cook until the cabbage is just tender. Serve with the fish and potatoes.
steps.tip: Cabbage should stay a little squeaky. Grey, collapsed cabbage has been in the pan too long.

image.alt: Baked haddock with cabbage and potatoes
